verdict.rationale: Sill's own support docs describe a Remote Access feature for using the Mac away from home through your own VPN (e.g. Tailscale) or a port forwarded on your router. The site adds that remote sessions start at a lower quality and move back to the home network automatically. The documentation shown is only a brief statement rather than a setup guide, and there is no hosted relay. missing for 10: step-by-step VPN/port-forward setup documentation (ports, router configuration), independent or hands-on corroboration that remote access works.

support.subject: As a power user, I can reach my machine away from home, with the relay, VPN, or port-forward path documented

citations.quote: Remote Access lets you use your Mac away from home, through your own VPN, such as Tailscale, or through a port you forward on your router.
Away from home, Sill starts at a quality a slower connection can carry, and when you get home, the session moves to your network by itself.
